span.p: IGH closes a review cycle in Dataverse

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
./sync-and-run-etl.sh
Sync, then bronze to silver to gold.
Leaves the gold database at data/star_schema.db

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
cp data/star_schema.db
Into the igh-dashboard checkout, as
backend/star_schema.db and backend/tests/star_schema.db

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
npm run check:all
Read the failures

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 npm run check:all
Regenerates the CSV golden files.
Edit the hard-coded counts by hand.

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p: Open a PR, merge to main

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Staging deploys automatically
with the committed database

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
In igh-airflow, bump the pinned commits:
uv lock --upgrade-package igh-data-sync
uv lock --upgrade-package igh-data-transform

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Merge and release igh-airflow.
The deploy rebuilds the image with the new packages.

div.style: color: rgb(61, 58, 54) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trigger the ingestion DAG.
Transform and deployment follow.
